:::caution[Not released yet]
HotLoop for CODESYS is built and has run against a real CODESYS runtime in the lab, and it is not out. It needs HotLoop 4.19.0, and the chart and the provisioner image are not published, so you can't install it yet. [Where it stands](/codesys/where-it-stands/) has the list.
:::

## What this is

0.3.0 is the first version of HotLoop for CODESYS: HotLoop Edge beside a CODESYS runtime, set up from a profile with nobody clicking. It needs HotLoop 4.19.0.

- **A chart that wraps HotLoop Edge** on the 4.19.0 line, with defaults for a runtime on the same node: SQLite on the node's own storage, no database pod, one replica, and the OPC UA server, the broker, edge publishing, and backups off.
- **A provisioner**, one static Go binary, that reads a [profile](/codesys/profile/) (the device, the variables to keep, the alarms, and one screen) and sets all of it up once the PLC's runtime answers. It looks again every five minutes.
- **A PLC that changes is followed.** A variable the profile lists that the PLC has gained since is added. One the PLC lost reads bad with the server's reason. The screen and the alarms are replaced only when the profile's revision is higher.
- **Nothing writes to the PLC.** Every tag the provisioner sets up is read-only.
- **Both pods tolerate an unreachable or not-ready node** with no time limit.
- **Sign-in from the EmberCORE dashboard** comes from the Edge chart's 4.19 sign-in, and this chart inherits it.

## What isn't proven

An install from the real App Store page, a physical controller, k3s v1.35.7, a node really losing its link to the control plane, a download from the CODESYS IDE while the runtime stays up, and a runtime on the host's own network beside the HotLoop pod. [Where it stands](/codesys/where-it-stands/) has the whole list and what it was run against.
